//: GriotModel as a deja-vu LOG SOURCE. Copy to <config-dir>/deja/sources.json
// WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: GriotModel is three inference lanes behind ONE OpenAI-compatible base_url
(fast-local Ollama :11434/v1 · big-local Colibri ./coli serve · cloud), per
thegriotmodel-codex. An inference endpoint does not persist conversations -
the CLIENT does. So 'GriotModel as a log source' resolves to: whichever
client drove the lane wrote the log, and this file tells deja where it is.
Already covered by deja's BUILT-IN adapters, nothing to configure:
Configure below only the clients deja has no adapter for.
// HOW TO ADAPT: root  - directory holding the logs; ~ and $VARS expand
map   - which JSON keys hold each field; dotted paths reach nested values
map.text is the only required one - without it there is nothing to index
map.session groups turns; omit it and each FILE becomes one session
Only format 'jsonl-messages' (one JSON object per line, one message per
object) is supported. A store with a different shape still needs a Go
adapter, which the runtime seam then registers - see register.go.

kinds.//: Adjust root/map to whatever actually writes your GriotModel turns.
kinds.name: griotmodel-log

// VERIFY: deja index          -> expect a line: 'griotmodel: N sessions, M messages'
deja --harness griotmodel "<something only that session said>"
deja sources        -> the harness is listed like any built-in
A misconfigured entry prints one line to stderr and costs that source only;
